newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-S.AFRICA NAME UNCHANGED TEAM FOR 3RD TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.AFRICA NAME UNCHANGED TEAM FOR 3RD TEST.

text.p: South Africa's selectors named an unchanged team for the third and final test against India in Johannesburg later this month.
The team which secured a 2-0 winning lead in the series with a 282-run victory in Cape Town on Monday will take on the Indians in the Wanderers test starting on January 16.
Northern Transvaal's off-spinning skipper Mark Davis has been called up as 12th man.
Northerns are without a match during the test.
Since their return to world cricket with the dismantling of apartheid, South Africa have not named their side until the morning of the match.
Team: Hansie Cronje (captain), Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Daryll Cullinan, Brian McMillan, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Lance Klusener, Allan Donald, Paul Adams.
